title: UnPattern
description: Removes bedrock pattern in SMP servers.
body:
This resource pack removes the bedrock pattern and obsidian pattern. Obsidian has some pattern issues, just in case. If you film and show off your bedrock, this can lead to detection on SMP servers. UnPattern replaces the bedrock pattern, making it standard and easily recognizable as bedrock, but the pattern itself won't be visible.

It's typically used by bloggers to avoid exposing their bedrock in streams and videos, similar to DonutSMP servers. Bedrock and obsidian are easy to understand and almost impossible to confuse.

Suitable for SMP servers.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
enjoy with this UnPattern resource-pack!


### Please note that this resource pack only works with versions 1.21.x, but may or may not work with some older versions. It may not work with other unknown or poorly designed resource packs you may be using, but it does work with stable resource packs.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

F.A.Q
Did it work on Forge?
- Yes, but in some versions Forge may not work

What Does it do?
- Removes the bedrock texture that can leak your base on servers, like DonutSMP

It is doing low fps?
Actually no, It takes few fps (Depending on your computer)
